onboarding.welcomeDesc: Your discreet, hardware-accelerated desktop productivity island at the top of your screen.
onboarding.step1Desc: Hover to peek or click to expand. Use the global shortcut to toggle anytime.
onboarding.step2Desc: Control Spotify, Apple Music, and media players with zero polling overhead.
onboarding.step3Desc: Drop any file or folder directly onto the island to inspect, copy paths, or store.
onboarding.step4Desc: Local-only encrypted clipboard history with sensitive token masking.
onboarding.step5Desc: Stay in flow with built-in countdowns, stopwatches, and Pomodoro cycles.

step1.title: Welcome to BBQ
step1.subtitle: Your Desktop Productivity Island
step1.description: BBQ transforms the top margin of your screen into an intelligent, hardware-accelerated command surface. It sits quietly as a compact pill and expands smoothly into productivity tools whenever you need them.
step1.tip: Tip: Hover or click the island at the top of your monitor to get started.

step2.title: Dynamic Island States
step2.subtitle: Fluid, GPU-accelerated interaction
step2.description: In idle mode, BBQ displays glanceable compact indicators for active media, running timers, clipboard preview, and system health. Dragging files over the island instantly turns it into a Drop Zone.
step2.tip: All animations are GPU-accelerated using transform and opacity for zero layout thrashing.

step3.title: Global Hotkey & Launcher
step3.subtitle: Instant access from anywhere
step3.description: Press Ctrl+Space (or Cmd+Space on macOS) globally to summon BBQ forward. The unified search launcher lets you open apps, files, or trigger system actions with deterministic keyboard speed.
step3.tip: You can customize the global hotkey combination anytime in Preferences.

step4.title: 100% Local & Privacy-First
step4.subtitle: Zero telemetry, zero tracking
step4.description: Your data never leaves your computer. Everything is stored locally in an embedded SQLite database. Features like Clipboard History are strictly opt-in and disabled by default.
step4.tip: Disabling clipboard history immediately purges stored clips from the database.

step5.title: Tailor Your Experience
step5.subtitle: Theme, accessibility & indicators
step5.description: BBQ supports System, Dark, and Light themes, along with dedicated Reduced Motion mode for accessibility. You can prioritize which compact indicators appear first in your island pill.
step5.tip: Use the theme buttons below to set your preferred appearance now:

step6.title: You're Ready to Launch!
step6.subtitle: Welcome to BBQ Production Edition
step6.description: You now have a fast, discreet productivity island at your command. Enjoy your streamlined desktop workflow!
step6.tip: You can replay this welcome tour anytime from the Preferences widget.
